# 2026-05-12 — Spring Board Meeting

- **[Hearthstone renewal](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md):** [Gregory Lang](../people/gregory-lang.md)
  reported the FY27 renewal as **verbally committed / likely** based on early conversations. Board
  planned FY27 assuming the ~$600K restricted grant would continue. *(Note: this optimistic read did
  not hold — see the [2026-07-15 grants update](2026-07-15-grants-update.md).)*
- **Development transition:** confirmed [Gregory Lang](../people/gregory-lang.md)'s departure
  (2026-04-30) and [Daniela Cruz](../people/daniela-cruz.md)'s step-up to Director of Development.
- **Reserve:** [James Whitfield](../people/james-whitfield.md) pressed on rebuilding toward the
  6-month reserve target.
- Board reviewed the [Spring Bright Futures cohort](../projects/bright-futures-spring.md) tracking
  toward strong college-enrollment numbers.
